words.enDefinition: make a messy place neat and in order

examples.en: Please tidy up the kitchen before your roommate gets home.
examples.zh: 室友到家之前，请把厨房「收拾整齐」。

examples.en: I spent twenty minutes tidying up my desk after class.
examples.zh: 下课后我花了二十分钟把书桌「收拾整齐」。

words.enDefinition: remove dirt and mess until a place is clean

examples.en: We all cleaned up the dorm room together on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 周日早上我们一起把宿舍「打扫干净」。

examples.en: Please clean up the microwave after you heat your food.
examples.zh: 热完食物后请把微波炉「清理干净」。

words.enDefinition: empty a space by removing everything inside

examples.en: I clean out the fridge every week so nothing goes moldy.
examples.zh: 我每周都会把冰箱「清空」一次，免得东西发霉。

examples.en: She cleaned out her desk drawer and found ten old pens.
examples.zh: 她把书桌抽屉「清理」了一遍，找到了十支旧笔。

words.enDefinition: clean a surface thoroughly with a damp cloth

examples.en: Could you wipe down the counter after you cook tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚做完饭后你能把操作台「擦干净」吗？

examples.en: I wiped down the desk with a damp cloth before studying.
examples.zh: 学习前我用湿布把书桌「擦干净」了。

words.enDefinition: return something to its usual storage place

examples.en: Put away your clothes before you start playing video games.
examples.zh: 打游戏之前先把衣服「收好」。

examples.en: Remember to put away the groceries as soon as we get home.
examples.zh: 到家后记得把采购的东西「收纳」好。

words.enDefinition: put something unwanted into the trash

examples.en: This milk smells sour, so you should throw it away.
examples.zh: 这牛奶发酸了，你应该把它「扔掉」。

examples.en: Don't throw away that box, I still need it for shipping.
examples.zh: 别把那个盒子「扔掉」，我寄快递还要用。

words.enDefinition: make a confusing situation organized and solved

examples.en: Give me an hour to sort out these receipts and bills.
examples.zh: 给我一个小时把这些收据和账单「理清」。

examples.en: We sorted out the schedule problem with one quick phone call.
examples.zh: 我们打了个简短的电话就把日程问题「解决」了。

words.enDefinition: bend something flat so it becomes smaller

examples.en: Fold up the map when you finish checking the route.
examples.zh: 查看完路线后把地图「叠起来」。

examples.en: She folds up her laundry before putting it in the drawer.
examples.zh: 她把洗好的衣服「叠起来」再放进抽屉。

words.enDefinition: finish the whole supply of something

examples.en: We always use up the dish soap before anyone remembers to buy more.
examples.zh: 总是等洗洁精「用光」，才有人想起来去买。

examples.en: Don't use up the hot water, I still want a shower.
examples.zh: 别把热水「用完」，我还要洗澡。

words.enDefinition: build something by joining its separate parts

examples.en: It took us two hours to put together the new bookshelf.
examples.zh: 我们花了两个小时才把新书架「组装」好。

examples.en: Can you help me put together this desk I bought online?
examples.zh: 你能帮我「拼装」这张网上买的桌子吗？

words.enDefinition: carry the garbage bags outside to the bin

examples.en: It's your turn to take out the trash tonight after dinner.
examples.zh: 今晚吃完饭轮到你「倒垃圾」。

examples.en: I'll take out the trash before the collection truck arrives.
examples.zh: 垃圾车来之前我会去「倒垃圾」。

collocations: take the trash out after dinner

words.enDefinition: wash the plates and pans after a meal

examples.en: If you cook dinner tonight, I'll do the dishes afterwards.
examples.zh: 今晚你做饭的话，饭后我来「洗碗」。

examples.en: Let the pans soak so doing the dishes is easier later.
examples.zh: 先把锅泡上，等会儿「洗碗」会轻松些。

words.enDefinition: In British English, hang washed clothes outside using pegs to secure them.

examples.en: Let's peg out the washing while there is still some sun in the back garden.
examples.zh: 趁后花园还有阳光，咱们「用夹子把衣物晾出去」吧。

examples.en: I usually peg out the washing before breakfast if the forecast looks dry.
examples.zh: 天气预报说没雨的话，我通常在吃早饭前「用夹子把衣物晾出去」。

collocations: peg out the washing in the garden
peg out the washing before breakfast

words.enDefinition: place dishes and cutlery ready for a meal

examples.en: You set the table and I'll bring the food out.
examples.zh: 你来「摆好餐具」，我把菜端出来。

examples.en: Our host asked us to help set the table for dinner.
examples.zh: 房东让我们帮忙为晚餐「摆好餐具」。

words.enDefinition: remove dishes and leftovers from the table after eating

examples.en: After we eat, please clear the table and wipe the surface.
examples.zh: 吃完饭请「收拾桌子」，并把桌面擦一擦。

examples.en: I'll clear the table if you wash the pans tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我来「收拾桌子」，你来刷锅。

words.enDefinition: arrange blankets and pillows neatly each morning

examples.en: Making the bed first makes my whole morning feel more organized.
examples.zh: 先「铺床」会让我一上午都感觉井井有条。

examples.en: Room check is at ten, so make the bed before you leave.
examples.zh: 十点查寝，所以出门前把床「铺好」。

words.enDefinition: take a dog outside on a leash for exercise

examples.en: I walk the dog around the block every evening after dinner.
examples.zh: 每天晚饭后我都会在街区周围「遛狗」。

examples.en: Can you walk the dog while I'm in class today?
examples.zh: 今天我上课时你能帮忙「遛狗」吗？

collocations: walk the dog twice a day
walk the dog in the park

words.enDefinition: remove something unwanted from your home or life

examples.en: We're selling these old textbooks to get rid of the clutter.
examples.zh: 我们打算把这些旧课本卖掉，「处理掉」闲置物品。

examples.en: How do I get rid of the smell in the mini fridge?
examples.zh: 怎样才能「清除」小冰箱里的异味？

collocations: get rid of a bad smell

words.enDefinition: take action to handle a problem or task

examples.en: I'll deal with the landlord about the broken doorknob tomorrow.
examples.zh: 门把手坏了的事，我明天去跟房东「处理」。

examples.en: She dealt with the noisy neighbors very calmly last week.
examples.zh: 上周她非常冷静地「应对」了吵闹的邻居。

words.enDefinition: have no more of something left to use

examples.en: We ran out of coffee filters, so can you buy some?
examples.zh: 咖啡滤纸「用完」了，你能买些吗？

examples.en: The printer ran out of ink in the middle of my essay.
examples.zh: 打印机在我打印论文时「没墨了」。

words.enDefinition: make cold food hot again before eating

examples.en: I'll heat up yesterday's pizza in the microwave for lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭我会用微波炉把昨天的披萨「加热」一下。

examples.en: Heat up the soup slowly so it doesn't boil over.
examples.zh: 汤「加热」时用小火，免得溢出来。

collocations: heat up soup in the microwave

words.enDefinition: quickly prepare a simple meal with little effort

examples.en: I can whip up some fried rice in ten minutes flat.
examples.zh: 十分钟内我就能「做好」一份炒饭。

examples.en: She whipped up a quick pasta after her late class ended.
examples.zh: 晚课结束后，她飞快地「做好」了一份意面。

words.enDefinition: have a meal at a restaurant, not at home

examples.en: Let's eat out tonight, I'm too tired to cook anything.
examples.zh: 今晚我们「下馆子」吧，我累得什么都不想做了。

examples.en: Eating out every day gets expensive really fast for students.
examples.zh: 对学生来说，天天「出去吃」花钱非常快。

words.enDefinition: have restaurant food delivered to your home

examples.en: It's raining hard tonight, so let's order in some noodles.
examples.zh: 今晚雨下得很大，我们「点外卖」吃面吧。

examples.en: We ordered in because nobody wanted to leave the dorm.
examples.zh: 因为没人想出门，我们「叫了外卖」。

collocations: order in on a rainy night

words.enDefinition: eat a very large amount of food at once

examples.en: We pigged out on hotpot right after the final exam.
examples.zh: 期末考试一结束我们就吃火锅「大吃了一顿」。

examples.en: I always pig out on snacks while binge-watching shows at night.
examples.zh: 我晚上追剧的时候总会「猛吃」零食。

words.enDefinition: leave your bed and start the day

examples.en: I get up at seven to catch the campus shuttle bus.
examples.zh: 我七点「起床」赶校车。

examples.en: She got up late and missed her morning lecture again.
examples.zh: 她今天「起床」晚了，又错过了早上的课。

words.enDefinition: stop sleeping and become awake

examples.en: I woke up to the sound of my roommate's alarm clock.
examples.zh: 我在室友闹钟的响声中「醒来」。

examples.en: Set two alarms in case you don't wake up on time.
examples.zh: 设两个闹钟，以防你到点没「睡醒」。

collocations: wake up in the middle of the night

words.enDefinition: remain awake much later than usual

examples.en: I stayed up finishing the essay and felt awful today.
examples.zh: 我「熬夜」赶完了论文，今天难受极了。

examples.en: Don't stay up chatting, we have an early class tomorrow.
examples.zh: 别「熬夜」聊天了，明天一早我们有课。

words.enDefinition: stay in bed longer than you normally do

examples.en: I love to sleep in on Sunday mornings after a long week.
examples.zh: 忙碌一周后，我最喜欢周日早上「睡懒觉」。

examples.en: She slept in and missed breakfast with us this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上「睡了个懒觉」，没赶上和我们一起吃早餐。

words.enDefinition: go to bed at the end of the day

examples.en: I'm exhausted after practice, so I'm turning in early tonight.
examples.zh: 训练完我累坏了，今晚要早点「睡觉」。

examples.en: It's getting late, so we should turn in pretty soon.
examples.zh: 时间不早了，我们该去「睡」了。

words.enDefinition: fall asleep briefly while sitting somewhere

examples.en: He nodded off during the movie and missed the ending.
examples.zh: 他看电影时「打起了瞌睡」，错过了结尾。

examples.en: I keep nodding off on the bus after my morning classes.
examples.zh: 上午的课上完之后，我在公交上总「打瞌睡」。

words.enDefinition: change from being awake to sleeping

examples.en: I fell asleep on the couch halfway through the movie.
examples.zh: 电影放到一半，我就在沙发上「睡着了」。

examples.en: Try to fall asleep before midnight so you wake up fresh.
examples.zh: 尽量在午夜前「入睡」，这样醒来才有精神。

words.enDefinition: move your body flat onto a bed or sofa

examples.en: I need to lie down for a bit after that long walk.
examples.zh: 走了那么久，我需要「躺下」歇一会儿。

examples.en: She lay down on her bed and read for a while.
examples.zh: 她「躺」在床上看了一会儿书。

words.enDefinition: move from standing into a chair or seat

examples.en: You look tired, sit down and have some water first.
examples.zh: 你看起来很累，先「坐下」喝点水吧。

examples.en: We sat down on the bench to wait for the next bus.
examples.zh: 我们「坐」在长椅上等下一班公交。

words.enDefinition: sleep for a short time during the day

examples.en: I take a nap after lunch to survive the afternoon classes.
examples.zh: 午饭后我会「小睡一会儿」，好撑过下午的课。

examples.en: He took a twenty-minute nap before his evening shift today.
examples.zh: 今天上晚班之前他「打了个盹」，睡了二十分钟。

words.enDefinition: wash your body under running water

examples.en: I take a shower right after I finish at the gym.
examples.zh: 我在健身房练完就「洗澡」。

examples.en: Wait for the water to get warm before you take a shower.
examples.zh: 等水热了再「洗澡」。

words.enDefinition: stop working for a short time to rest

examples.en: You've been studying for hours, so take a break now.
examples.zh: 你已经连着学好几个小时了，现在「休息一下」吧。

examples.en: Let's take a coffee break between our two morning lectures.
examples.zh: 上午两节课之间我们「歇一下」，喝杯咖啡。

words.enDefinition: wear nicer or special clothes for an occasion

examples.en: Do we need to dress up for the birthday dinner tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚的生日晚宴需要我们「盛装出席」吗？

examples.en: The kids dressed up as ghosts for the Halloween party.
examples.zh: 万圣节派对上孩子们「装扮」成了幽灵。

words.enDefinition: place a piece of clothing or glasses onto your body

examples.en: Put on a jacket before you go out tonight, it's cold.
examples.zh: 今晚出门前「穿上」外套，外面很冷。

examples.en: He put on his glasses to read the small print.
examples.zh: 他「戴上」眼镜看那些小字。

words.enDefinition: remove a piece of clothing or your shoes

examples.en: Take off your wet coat before you catch a cold.
examples.zh: 把湿外套「脱掉」，免得感冒。

examples.en: We take off our shoes at the door in this apartment.
examples.zh: 这间公寓进门要「脱鞋」。

words.enDefinition: wear clothes briefly to check the fit

examples.en: Try on the jeans before you decide which size to buy.
examples.zh: 先「试穿」这条牛仔裤，再决定买哪个尺码。

examples.en: She tried on three dresses but ended up buying none.
examples.zh: 她把三条裙子都「试穿」了，结果一件也没买。

collocations: try on clothes in the fitting room

words.enDefinition: wear many warm layers in cold weather

examples.en: Bundle up before you head out, it's freezing this morning.
examples.zh: 出门前「穿暖和些」，今天早上特别冷。

examples.en: We bundled up in scarves and gloves for the long walk.
examples.zh: 长距离散步时，我们用围巾手套把自己「裹得严严实实」。

words.enDefinition: close a jacket or bag using its zipper

examples.en: Zip up your hoodie, the wind is getting stronger outside.
examples.zh: 「拉上」卫衣拉链，外面的风越来越大了。

examples.en: She zipped up her backpack and hurried off to class.
examples.zh: 她「拉好」背包拉链，匆匆赶去上课。

words.enDefinition: record information on paper so you remember it

examples.en: Write down the wifi password before you forget it again.
examples.zh: 趁还没忘，把无线网密码「写下来」。

examples.en: I wrote down the meeting spot that she suggested yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我把她建议的碰头地点「记了下来」。

words.enDefinition: draw a line through written text to delete it

examples.en: Cross out the items you've already bought on the list.
examples.zh: 把清单上已经买到的项目「划掉」。

examples.en: He crossed out his old phone number on the form.
examples.zh: 他把表格上的旧手机号「划掉」了。

words.enDefinition: find information in a book or on the internet

examples.en: I looked up the bus timetable on my phone yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我用手机「查了」公交时刻表。

examples.en: Look up the word in a dictionary if you're unsure.
examples.zh: 不确定的话就「查一下」词典。

words.enDefinition: understand something by thinking carefully about it

examples.en: I finally figured out how the shared washing machine works.
examples.zh: 我终于「搞懂」了公用洗衣机怎么用。

examples.en: We need to figure out who's bringing the cooler on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我们得「弄清楚」周六谁带保温箱。

words.enDefinition: learn a fact you did not know before

examples.en: I found out that the library closes early on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我「打听到」图书馆周五很早闭馆。

examples.en: Call the store to find out if they still have stock.
examples.zh: 打电话给店里「问问」还有没有货。

words.enDefinition: quickly review skills or knowledge you once had

examples.en: I'm brushing up on my spoken English before the trip.
examples.zh: 出发前我在「温习」英语口语。

examples.en: She brushed up on her Italian before visiting Rome in May.
examples.zh: 五月去罗马之前，她「重温」了一下意大利语。

words.enDefinition: review something carefully from beginning to end

examples.en: Let's go over the shopping list one more time together.
examples.zh: 我们一起把购物清单再「过一遍」。

examples.en: The tutor went over our mistakes after the practice quiz.
examples.zh: 练习测验后，辅导老师把我们的错题「讲解」了一遍。

words.enDefinition: examine things or pages quickly, one by one

examples.en: She looked through the flyers for student apartment listings downtown.
examples.zh: 她在传单里「翻看」市里学生公寓的租房信息。

examples.en: I looked through my photos from the trip last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我「翻看」了那次旅行的照片。

words.enDefinition: find something by chance while doing something else

examples.en: I came across an old photo of us while organizing files.
examples.zh: 整理文件时，我「偶然翻到」了我们的一张旧照片。

examples.en: You'll come across some great cafes if you explore the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 在附近转转，你会「偶然发现」一些很棒的咖啡馆。

words.enDefinition: phone someone again after missing their call

examples.en: I missed his call, so I'll call back after dinner.
examples.zh: 我没接到他的电话，晚饭后再「回电话」。

examples.en: Can you call the landlord back about the viewing time?
examples.zh: 你能「回电」房东确认看房时间吗？

collocations: call back as soon as possible

words.enDefinition: contact someone later with your answer

examples.en: Let me check my schedule and get back to you tonight.
examples.zh: 我看一下日程，今晚「回复你」。

examples.en: She never got back to me about the weekend plans.
examples.zh: 关于周末的安排，她一直没「回复我」。

collocations: get back to someone about something
get back to me by Friday

words.enDefinition: raise your voice so people can hear you

examples.en: Could you speak up? The music here is really loud.
examples.zh: 你能「大声一点」吗？这里的音乐声太大了。

examples.en: Grandpa asked me to speak up during our phone call.
examples.zh: 爷爷让我打电话时「说大声些」。

collocations: speak up in a noisy place

words.enDefinition: tell someone a fact or mistake they missed

examples.en: He pointed out that we forgot the power adapter again.
examples.zh: 他「指出」我们又忘了带电源转换头。

examples.en: Thank you for pointing out the typo in my message.
examples.zh: 谢谢你「指出」我消息里的错别字。

words.enDefinition: start talking about a subject in conversation

examples.en: Don't bring up the rent issue at dinner tonight, please.
examples.zh: 今晚吃饭时请别「提起」房租的事。

examples.en: She brought up an interesting idea during our long chat.
examples.zh: 长聊时她「提出」了一个有意思的想法。

words.enDefinition: stay in contact with someone over time

examples.en: Let's keep in touch after the exchange program ends next month.
examples.zh: 下个月交换项目结束后我们「保持联系」。

examples.en: I still keep in touch with my high school roommates.
examples.zh: 我和高中室友至今仍「保持联系」。

words.enDefinition: end a phone call by putting the phone down

examples.en: She hung up before I could explain anything at all.
examples.zh: 我还没来得及解释，她就「挂了电话」。

examples.en: Don't hang up on me, I'm entering my card number now.
examples.zh: 别「挂断电话」，我正在输入卡号。

words.enDefinition: spend relaxed time with friends without a plan

examples.en: Do you want to hang out with us this Saturday afternoon?
examples.zh: 这周六下午想不想和我们一起「出去玩」？

examples.en: We usually hang out at the coffee shop near campus.
examples.zh: 我们通常在学校附近的咖啡店「消磨时光」。

words.enDefinition: visit someone's home for a short time

examples.en: Come over after class this evening, we're ordering pizza together.
examples.zh: 今晚下课后「过来」吧，我们一起订披萨。

examples.en: My next-door neighbor came over to borrow a screwdriver yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天隔壁邻居「过来」借了一把螺丝刀。

words.enDefinition: meet as a group for fun or a meal

examples.en: Let's get together for hotpot this weekend before finals week.
examples.zh: 这周末期末周开始前我们「聚一聚」吃火锅吧。

examples.en: Our old classmates get together at least once a year.
examples.zh: 老同学们每年至少「聚」一次。

words.enDefinition: arrange to meet someone at an agreed place

examples.en: Let's meet up at the library entrance at two o'clock.
examples.zh: 两点我们在图书馆门口「碰头」。

examples.en: I'm meeting up with my study group in the library this evening.
examples.zh: 今晚我要在图书馆和学习小组「见面」。

words.enDefinition: share news with a friend you have not seen recently

examples.en: We met for bubble tea and caught up for two hours.
examples.zh: 我们约着喝奶茶，「聊了」两个小时近况。

examples.en: It's been months since we met, so we should catch up soon.
examples.zh: 都好几个月没见了，我们该「叙叙旧」了。

collocations: catch up with an old friend
catch up on each other's lives

words.enDefinition: visit someone briefly without an appointment

examples.en: I'll drop by your dorm to return the notes tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天会「顺便去趟」你宿舍还笔记。

examples.en: Feel free to drop by my place anytime after five.
examples.zh: 五点以后随时欢迎来我家「坐坐」。

words.enDefinition: meet someone unexpectedly by chance

examples.en: I ran into my cousin at the grocery store downtown.
examples.zh: 我在市区的超市「偶遇」了表哥。

examples.en: You'll never guess who I ran into on campus today.
examples.zh: 你绝对猜不到我今天在校园里「碰见」了谁。

words.enDefinition: invite someone on a romantic date

examples.en: He finally asked her out to the autumn festival on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五他终于「约她出去」逛秋日集市了。

examples.en: Nervously, I asked my classmate out for coffee after lecture.
examples.zh: 我紧张地「约」同学下课后出去喝咖啡。

collocations: ask someone out on a date

words.enDefinition: end a romantic relationship

examples.en: They broke up after two years of doing long distance.
examples.zh: 异地恋两年后，他们「分手」了。

examples.en: She finally broke up with him calmly after months of arguing.
examples.zh: 争吵了几个月后，她终于平静地和他「分手」了。

words.enDefinition: fail to show up at an arranged meeting

examples.en: He stood me up at the cinema and never texted back.
examples.zh: 他「放了我鸽子」，人没到电影院，消息也不回。

examples.en: She was stood up once and never forgot how it felt.
examples.zh: 她「被放鸽子」过一次，一直没忘记那种滋味。

collocations: stand someone up on a date

words.enDefinition: disappoint someone by failing to help as expected

examples.en: I promised to help you move, I won't let you down.
examples.zh: 我答应过帮你搬家，不会「让你失望」的。

examples.en: He let his teammates down by skipping practice twice last month.
examples.zh: 上个月他两次不去训练，让队友们「很失望」。

words.enDefinition: have a friendly relationship with someone

examples.en: My roommate and I get along really well this year.
examples.zh: 今年我和室友「相处得很融洽」。

examples.en: Do you get along well with your new next-door neighbors?
examples.zh: 你和隔壁的新邻居「合得来」吗？

words.enDefinition: guide a visitor to see a new place

examples.en: Let me show you around the neighborhood this weekend if you're free.
examples.zh: 这周末你要是有空，我带你「逛逛」附近。

examples.en: She showed the visiting students around the main campus this morning.
examples.zh: 今天上午她带来访的学生「参观」了主校园。

words.enDefinition: give practical help when someone is busy

examples.en: Can you help out with the groceries this afternoon after class?
examples.zh: 今天下午下课后你能「帮个忙」搬采购的东西吗？

examples.en: He often helps out at the food bank on Sundays.
examples.zh: 周日他常去食物银行「帮忙」。

words.enDefinition: join others in sharing a task or job

examples.en: Everyone in our flat pitched in to clean the shared kitchen tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我们公寓里所有人都「出力」打扫了公用厨房。

examples.en: We all pitched in to set up the party decorations.
examples.zh: 我们都「搭把手」布置了派对装饰。

words.enDefinition: add money to a shared amount for a purchase

examples.en: We each chipped in ten dollars for the shared pizza.
examples.zh: 那份披萨我们每人「凑了」十美元。

examples.en: Can you chip in for Sarah's birthday gift with us?
examples.zh: 莎拉的生日礼物你能和我们一起「凑份子」吗？

words.enDefinition: give your own things to others for free

examples.en: She's giving away all her old textbooks to younger students.
examples.zh: 她要把所有旧课本都「送」给学弟学妹。

examples.en: We gave away most of the extra furniture before moving out.
examples.zh: 搬走之前我们把大部分多余的家具「送掉」了。

words.enDefinition: return something borrowed to its owner

examples.en: I need to give back Maria's calculator tomorrow morning before class.
examples.zh: 明天早上上课前，我得把玛丽亚的计算器「还」给她。

examples.en: Remember to give back the spare keys before you leave.
examples.zh: 走之前记得把备用钥匙「还回去」。

words.enDefinition: look after a person, pet, or task

examples.en: Can you take care of my cat this weekend while I'm away?
examples.zh: 这周末我不在，你能帮我「照顾」我的猫吗？

examples.en: I'll take care of the groceries while you cook dinner.
examples.zh: 你做晚饭，采购的事我来「打理」。

words.enDefinition: keep someone or something safe and well

examples.en: Could you look after my plants for one week in July?
examples.zh: 七月份你能帮我「照看」花草一个星期吗？

examples.en: She looked after her little cousin all afternoon while we shopped.
examples.zh: 我们逛街的时候，她整个下午都在「照顾」小表弟。

words.enDefinition: watch something carefully to keep it safe

examples.en: Keep an eye on the soup while I take this call.
examples.zh: 我接个电话，你帮忙「看着」汤。

examples.en: Please keep an eye on my suitcase at the station.
examples.zh: 在车站请帮我「留意」一下行李箱。

collocations: keep an eye on the food
keep an eye on your bag
keep an eye on the kids

words.enDefinition: be alert to possible danger around you

examples.en: Watch out for the bike lane when you cross here.
examples.zh: 在这儿过马路要「当心」自行车道。

examples.en: Watch out for the wet floor near the sink in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房水池边地板很滑，「小心」点。

words.enDefinition: rely on someone to do what is needed

examples.en: You can count on me to bring the tickets tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚带票这事你可以「指望」我。

examples.en: I'm counting on you to water the plants this week.
examples.zh: 这周浇花就「靠」你了。

words.enDefinition: succeed in arriving or attending something

examples.en: Sorry, I can't make it to dinner tonight because of lab.
examples.zh: 抱歉，因为有实验课，今晚我「来不了」聚餐了。

examples.en: We made it to the airport just in time for boarding.
examples.zh: 我们及时「赶到」机场，正好赶上登机。

words.enDefinition: stop trying to do something difficult

examples.en: Don't give up now, you're almost through the hard part.
examples.zh: 现在别「放弃」，最难的部分快过去了。

examples.en: He gave up learning guitar two years ago but restarted this year.
examples.zh: 他两年前曾「放弃」学吉他，今年又重新开始了。

collocations: give up on the first try

words.enDefinition: want to have or do something right now

examples.en: I don't feel like cooking tonight, so let's order something.
examples.zh: 今晚我「不想」做饭了，我们点些吃的吧。

examples.en: Do you feel like bubble tea after our last class?
examples.zh: 最后一节课下课后你「想不想」喝奶茶？

words.enDefinition: become comfortable with something new over time

examples.en: It took me a month to get used to the cold winters here.
examples.zh: 我花了一个月才「习惯」这里寒冷的冬天。

examples.en: You'll soon get used to speaking English every single day.
examples.zh: 你很快就会「习惯」每天说英语的。

collocations: get used to a new schedule
get used to speaking another language

words.enDefinition: check something so it is certain to be true

examples.en: Make sure the door is locked before you leave tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚出门前「确认」门已锁好。

examples.en: I made sure the oven was completely off this time.
examples.zh: 这次我特意「确认」烤箱已经完全关了。

collocations: make sure you have your keys

words.enDefinition: return money that someone lent you

examples.en: I'll pay you back the twenty dollars on Friday, promise.
examples.zh: 周五我就把这二十美元「还」给你，说到做到。

examples.en: She paid back her roommate for the movie tickets last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚她把电影票的钱「还」给了室友。

words.enDefinition: keep money gradually for a future purchase

examples.en: I'm saving up for a new laptop before term starts.
examples.zh: 开学前我正在为换新笔记本电脑「攒钱」。

examples.en: She saved up for two months to buy the bicycle.
examples.zh: 她「攒了」两个月的钱才买下那辆自行车。

collocations: save up for a new phone

words.enDefinition: return a purchase to the store

examples.en: This jacket is too small, so I'll take it back tomorrow.
examples.zh: 这件夹克太小了，我明天拿去「退掉」。

examples.en: You need the receipt if you take the shoes back.
examples.zh: 「退鞋」的话需要出示收据。

collocations: take an item back to the store

words.enDefinition: choose one item from a group

examples.en: Can you pick out a nice birthday card for Leo?
examples.zh: 你能帮利奥「挑」一张好看的生日贺卡吗？

examples.en: She picked out the ripest bananas at the street market.
examples.zh: 她在街边市场里「挑」了最熟的香蕉。

words.enDefinition: compare prices at different stores before buying

examples.en: Shop around online before you buy the flight ticket home.
examples.zh: 买回家的机票前先在网上「货比三家」。

examples.en: We shopped around and found a much cheaper phone plan.
examples.zh: 我们「多比了几家」，找到了便宜得多的手机套餐。

collocations: shop around for the best price

words.enDefinition: test something new to see if you like it

examples.en: I want to try out that new bubble tea shop nearby.
examples.zh: 我想去「试试」附近新开的那家奶茶店。

examples.en: She tried out the free gym pass this whole week.
examples.zh: 这一周她「试用」了健身房体验卡。

collocations: try out a gym for free

words.enDefinition: write the answers on an official form

examples.en: Fill out this form and hand it to the front desk.
examples.zh: 「填好」这张表格，然后交给前台。

examples.en: I filled out the delivery form in just five minutes.
examples.zh: 我只用了五分钟就「填完」了快递单。

words.enDefinition: buy a large amount of something for later use

examples.en: Let's stock up on noodles before the storm arrives tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚暴风雨来之前，我们多「囤」些泡面。

examples.en: I stocked up on snacks and drinks for our movie night.
examples.zh: 电影之夜前我「囤了」不少零食和饮料。

words.enDefinition: use or spend less of something than before

examples.en: I'm cutting back on bubble tea to save some money.
examples.zh: 为了省点钱，我在「少喝」奶茶。

examples.en: He cut back on late-night snacks for the whole month.
examples.zh: 他一整个月都在「减少」宵夜。

words.enDefinition: do small practical jobs around town

examples.en: I'm running errands downtown this afternoon, so do you need anything?
examples.zh: 今天下午我要去市区「办点杂事」，你需要带什么吗？

examples.en: She spent the whole morning running errands around the campus area.
examples.zh: 她一上午都在学校周边「跑腿办事」。

words.enDefinition: leave a place to start a trip or errand

examples.en: We should head out before rush hour starts at five.
examples.zh: 五点高峰期开始前我们该「出发」了。

examples.en: I'm heading out to the post office in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 十分钟后我「出门」去邮局。

words.enDefinition: return toward the place you came from

examples.en: It's getting dark, so let's head back to the dorm.
examples.zh: 天快黑了，我们「回」宿舍吧。

examples.en: I headed back home right after my last morning class.
examples.zh: 上午最后一节课一结束我就「往回走」了。

words.enDefinition: begin a journey from your starting point

examples.en: We set off early to avoid the holiday traffic jams.
examples.zh: 为了避开假日的堵车，我们一大早就「动身」了。

examples.en: They set off for the coast right after sunrise on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六日出刚过他们就「出发」去海边了。

collocations: set off early in the morning
set off on a road trip

words.enDefinition: take someone or something to a place and leave

examples.en: I'll drop you off at the station on my way.
examples.zh: 顺路我「送你到」车站。

examples.en: She dropped off the package at the post office today.
examples.zh: 她今天把包裹「送到」了邮局。

words.enDefinition: make a container or tank completely full

examples.en: Fill up my water bottle before we leave for class, please.
examples.zh: 出发上课前请帮我把水壶「装满」水。

examples.en: We filled up the tank before the long drive home.
examples.zh: 回家长途开车前我们把油箱「加满」了。

words.enDefinition: travel from place to place in a city

examples.en: It's really easy to get around this city by bicycle.
examples.zh: 在这座城市骑自行车「出行」真的很方便。

examples.en: How do you usually get around without a car here?
examples.zh: 在这里没车你平时怎么「四处走动」？

words.enDefinition: drive a car to the roadside and stop

examples.en: He pulled over to the side to check the flat tire safely.
examples.zh: 他把车「停到路边」，安全地检查瘪胎。

examples.en: Let's pull over here and check the route map again.
examples.zh: 我们在这儿「靠边停一下」，再看一遍路线图。

words.enDefinition: reduce your speed while moving or working

examples.en: Slow down near the school zone, the limit drops here.
examples.zh: 学校区域附近要「减速」，这里限速更低。

examples.en: I've been rushing all week, so it's time to slow down.
examples.zh: 这一整周我都赶个不停，该「放慢节奏」了。

words.enDefinition: move or act faster because time is short

examples.en: Hurry up, the campus bus leaves in just five minutes.
examples.zh: 「赶快」，校车五分钟后就发车了。

examples.en: We hurried up but still missed the first train of the day.
examples.zh: 我们一路「抓紧」，还是没赶上当天的第一班火车。

collocations: hurry up or we'll be late

words.enDefinition: return to the place you left

examples.en: I'll come back for my umbrella this evening around six.
examples.zh: 今晚六点左右我会「回来」拿伞。

examples.en: He came back to the dorm after buying groceries downtown.
examples.zh: 他在市区买完菜就「回」宿舍了。

words.enDefinition: leave home to enjoy social activities

examples.en: Do you want to go out for hotpot tonight with us?
examples.zh: 今晚想不想和我们「出去」吃火锅？

examples.en: We went out for hotpot with our classmates last Friday evening.
examples.zh: 上周五晚上我们和同学一起「出去吃」了火锅。

words.enDefinition: connect a device to the electricity supply

examples.en: Plug in the kettle before you boil the water, please.
examples.zh: 烧水前请先把水壶「插上电源」。

examples.en: My phone died because I forgot to plug it in.
examples.zh: 手机没电了，因为我忘了「插上充电器」。

words.enDefinition: say no to an offer or invitation

examples.en: She turned down the party invitation to study for finals.
examples.zh: 为了备考期末，她「拒绝」了派对邀请。

examples.en: He turned down the extra shift because of his exams.
examples.zh: 因为要考试，他「谢绝」了额外的排班。

words.enDefinition: stop a machine or light from working

examples.en: Turn off the lights when you leave the room, please.
examples.zh: 离开房间时请把灯「关掉」。

examples.en: Did you turn off the stove after cooking dinner last night?
examples.zh: 昨晚做完晚饭后你把炉灶「关」了吗？

words.enDefinition: make a paper copy of a computer file

examples.en: I need to print out my boarding pass tonight before ten.
examples.zh: 今晚十点前我得把登机牌「打印」出来。

examples.en: She printed out the recipe to keep in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 她把菜谱「打印出来」放在厨房备用。

words.enDefinition: prepare a device or place so it is ready to use

examples.en: It took an hour to set up the new printer upstairs.
examples.zh: 「装好」楼上的新打印机花了一个小时。

examples.en: We set up the projector in the common room for movie night.
examples.zh: 电影之夜我们在公共活动室「布置好」了投影仪。

words.enDefinition: look at something interesting to judge it for yourself

examples.en: You should really check out the night market near campus.
examples.zh: 你真应该去「逛逛」学校附近的夜市。

examples.en: Check out this funny video my cousin just sent me.
examples.zh: 「瞧瞧」我表哥刚发给我的这个搞笑视频。

words.enDefinition: finally be in a place or situation, often unplanned

examples.en: We ended up walking home because the last bus had left.
examples.zh: 末班车已经开走，我们「最后只好」走路回家。

examples.en: He ended up staying the night on our couch after the party.
examples.zh: 派对结束后，他「最后」就在我们家的沙发上过夜了。

words.enDefinition: prove to be true or good in the end

examples.en: The small party turned out better than we had expected.
examples.zh: 这场小型派对「结果」比我们预期的更好。

examples.en: It turned out that the store was closed on Mondays.
examples.zh: 「原来」那家店周一不营业。

words.enDefinition: happen or appear unexpectedly in life or talk

examples.en: Something came up at home, so I'll be a bit late.
examples.zh: 家里突然「有事」，我会晚一点到。

examples.en: That old topic came up again during dinner yesterday evening.
examples.zh: 昨晚吃饭时又「聊到」了那个老话题。

words.enDefinition: think of an idea or plan suddenly

examples.en: We came up with a cheaper travel plan together last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我们一起「想出了」一个更省钱的出行方案。

examples.en: She came up with a great gift idea for her mom.
examples.zh: 她给妈妈「想到」一个很棒的礼物点子。

words.enDefinition: begin to feel the signs of an illness

examples.en: I think I'm coming down with a cold before the trip.
examples.zh: 出发前我好像「染上」感冒了。

examples.en: He came down with the flu during finals week last year.
examples.zh: 去年期末周他「得了」流感。

words.enDefinition: manage to survive a difficult period or task

examples.en: Strong coffee helped me get through exam week this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期浓咖啡帮我「熬过」了考试周。

examples.en: We got through the busiest month of the year together.
examples.zh: 我们一起「挺过」了今年最忙的一个月。

words.enDefinition: experience something difficult or unpleasant

examples.en: Anyone who moves abroad goes through an adjustment period first.
examples.zh: 刚出国的人都要先「经历」一段适应期。

examples.en: He went through a tough time after failing the driving test.
examples.zh: 驾照考试没过后，他「经历」了一段难熬的日子。

words.enDefinition: continue doing something without stopping

examples.en: Carry on with your homework while I start making dinner.
examples.zh: 你「继续」写作业，我去开始做晚饭。

examples.en: They carried on chatting until well after midnight that night.
examples.zh: 那晚他们一直「接着聊」到午夜过后。

words.enDefinition: move or progress as fast as someone or something

examples.en: It's hard to keep up with all the group chat messages.
examples.zh: 群消息太多，很难全部「跟上」。

examples.en: He walks so fast that I can't keep up with him.
examples.zh: 他走得太快，我「跟不上」他。

collocations: keep up with a fast walker

words.enDefinition: make less progress than others around you

examples.en: I fell behind on my reading during the long holiday.
examples.zh: 长假期间我的阅读进度「落后」了。

examples.en: He fell behind the group halfway through the long hike.
examples.zh: 长途远足走到一半他就「掉队」了。

words.enDefinition: start a new hobby or activity

examples.en: I took up badminton to make new friends this year.
examples.zh: 今年我为了交新朋友「开始打」羽毛球。

examples.en: She wants to take up photography as a hobby this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天她想「开始学」摄影，培养个爱好。
